description.content: While you are not the Obsession:

items: While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras.
Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or the Obsession finishes healing you, while within [16m] of each other, you both gain [7%] [Haste].

description.content: While you are the Obsession, if you are hooked, another Survivor becomes the Obsession.
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
